specification_compliance: No findings were listed for verification, and no unspecified behaviors were listed for scoring.

I1 spot check: outside tests, the only callers of deleteWatchProgress are the user-initiated 'Remove from history' paths (ContinueWatchingSection.tsx:106, CardFileMenu.tsx:313). The playback-completion path in the queue module calls neither deleteWatchProgress nor clearProgress.

I2 spot check: nextPlayableAfter (queue.ts:44-60) searches forward for a playable item, wraps only with loop on, stops before the ended item, and returns null when nothing qualifies. FolderQueueHost.onEnded (FolderQueueHost.tsx:245-249) acts only when the queue is ready and goes through playFile, which calls requestPlay and then selectFile.

I3/I10 spot check: queueWalk (queue.ts:85-99) walks every entry without wrapping, returns a 1-based position, and returns null prev/next/position when the open file is not in the queue, while total stays the item count.
I5 spot check: FolderQueueHost.handleClose (FolderQueueHost.tsx:257-266) removes queue, sort and order.
I14 spot check: the collection-loop key is written only through setLoopStorage, which is called only from the loop toggles in CollectionDetail.tsx:330-332 and FolderQueueHost.tsx:229-235.
I15 spot check: under sort=random the folder queue uses the stored queue when one exists (FolderQueueHost.tsx:145-152).
regression_risks: The loop state is read from storage once per host mount (FolderQueueHost.tsx:81, CollectionDetail.tsx:75). A toggle in another mounted host or another tab is not picked up until remount. This was not examined beyond reading the code.
